Olympic shooting  replicating exact competition mechanics, delivering unmatched accuracy for training and recreational perfection.



>> Features of Olympic Shooting:


  • Realistic Olympic Mechanics: Simulates the exact feel, rules, and scoring systems of Olympic shooting competitions.

  • High-Precision Tracking: Utilizes infrared and laser-based tracking for pinpoint accuracy and instant feedback.

  • Multiple Shooting Modes: Includes pistol, rifle, and moving target disciplines.

  • Digital Scoring & Replay: Instant scoring display and shot-by-shot replays for performance analysis.

  • Immersive Visual & Sound Effects: HD visuals and realistic soundscapes for true-to-life shooting environments.

  • Safe & Accessible Design: All-digital system with no live ammunition, suitable for users of all experience levels.



>> Advantages and Applications for the Olympic Shooting:



Professional-Level Training: Ideal for athletes preparing for high-level competition.


Skill Development: Enhances focus, hand-eye coordination, and accuracy.


Recreational Excellence: Offers an engaging and competitive experience for casual users and gaming venues.


Safe Learning Environment: Perfect for beginners and youth shooters to learn in a risk-free setup.


Versatile Deployment: Great for use in training centers, amusement parks, military academies, schools, and sports clubs.



>> Product Number: LJST008


  • Floor area: 10m*1m*2.5m

  • Number of people: 1-4 person

  • Participation time: 3-10 minutes

  • Power: 130w



>> FAQs for Olympic Shooting:


Q1: Is this suitable for Olympic training?

A1: Yes, the simulator replicates Olympic standards and is suitable for serious training purposes.


Q2: Are there different difficulty levels?

A2: Yes, users can choose from beginner to professional modes, with adjustable target speed and sensitivity.


Q3: Is the system safe for children?

A3: Absolutely. It uses digital sensors and does not involve live ammunition, making it safe for supervised youth use.


Q4: Can it simulate different types of firearms?

A4: Yes, it supports a variety of shooting disciplines including air pistol, rifle, and rapid fire.


Q5: What space is required for installation?

A5: The system is modular and scalable, suitable for small training rooms or large competition halls.
